## Data coverage and timing

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_metadata(snapshot, "DK2")
```

Times on charts and tables are **Europe/Copenhagen**, including CET/CEST.
The snapshot generation time above is UTC. Prices beyond today are shown only
when published by the market provider. Missing or incomplete coverage is
reported in the coverage details; a missing recommendation means that no
complete eligible window was available.

## Read the right price

**Wholesale spot** is the bidding-zone market price before VAT and consumer
charges. The recommended windows and period averages use this wholesale basis.
Negative spot prices are retained on charts and in tables.

**Radius / Andel consumer scenario** is an hourly estimate for a private customer
in Radius' area with Andel FlexEnergi, including VAT and variable charges.
It excludes fixed subscriptions. It is shown separately on the
[East Denmark page](east-denmark.qmd); actual bills depend on the agreement.

See [price components](price-components.qmd) for the scenario and
[temperature and electricity prices](heatpump.qmd) for weather context.

::: {.publication-note}
Use the timestamped tables to schedule a load. The lowest wholesale window can
differ from the lowest consumer-cost window because network charges vary by hour.
:::
